description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-structs-and-module-calls.html (approved 2026-11-11) supersedes /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-3ul.4.html. Prerequisites are epic fz-3sy: structs are maps, calls on a module value, defoverridable, field defaults (fz-sc8.95), built-in exceptions in lib with raise as Elixir's macro (fz-3sy.8).

Build, as Elixir's kernel.ex: defexception fields -> defstruct([__exception__: true] ++ fields) plus defoverridable exception/1 (binary -> message:, list -> struct!) and message/1 (when there is a message field). Exception.message/1 is e.__struct__.message(e), a module-value call. is_exception/1 guard. The uncaught banner through message/1 is fz-3sy.9, after this.

Acceptance (interp, run, build; elixir oracle):
- defexception with a message field: raise Mod, message: "x" rescued by alias, e.message is "x"; default message when raised bare.
- custom message/1 used by Exception.message/1.
- raise Mod, attrs builds the struct through exception/1; a user-defined exception/1 is honoured.
- raise 42 -> ArgumentError "raise/1 and reraise/2 expect a module name, string or exception as the first argument, got: 42".
- is_exception/1 true for a raised struct, false for a plain map with __struct__ only.
- exceptions doc gains the struct section; guides updated if they mention exceptions.
- gate green.
title: defexception, raise Mod, attrs and Exception.message/1
